components.css: .ds-service{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid hsl(214.3 31.8% 91.4%);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%);font-family:IRANSansX,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-service:hover{border-color:hsl(215 20% 75%);background:hsl(210 40% 98%)}.ds-service:focus-visible{outline:2px solid hsl(221.2 83.2% 53.3%);outline-offset:2px}.ds-service-icon{display:grid;width:44px;height:44px;place-items:center;border:1px solid hsl(214.3 31.8% 91.4%);border-radius:6px}.ds-service strong,.ds-service small{display:block}.ds-service strong{font-size:16px}.ds-service small{margin-top:4px;color:hsl(215.4 16.3% 46.9%);font-size:13px;font-weight:400}

narrative.overview: Nobino behaves like a well-run internal service counter: composed, predictable, and quick to scan. The interface is deliberately operational rather than promotional. Hierarchy comes from spacing, weight, alignment, and restrained blue emphasis instead of decorative surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained blue action color over white and cool neutral surfaces
Borders and tonal shifts before shadows
Familiar controls with explicit focus and state feedback

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action or active state; it is not scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Natural Persian Rule
rules.body: Do not add Latin-style tracking, uppercase conventions, or ornamental italics to Persian interface text.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Ordinary cards and controls do not need a shadow to exist.

dos: Prioritize service recognition and current task state over decorative content.
Use spacing, borders, and weight to establish hierarchy.
Keep Persian labels concise and dates naturally ordered in Jalali form.
Preserve familiar links, buttons, inputs, and keyboard behavior.
donts: Turn every grouping into a floating card.
Introduce gradients, glass effects, ornamental serif typography, or generic marketing copy.
Use muted text where the contrast becomes ambiguous.
Replace explicit status language with color or icons alone.
